item.title: San Diego counter-drone tech company explains risks of Iran drone threat following FBI warning
item.description: A San Diego-based counter-drone technology company is explaining how potential Iranian drone attacks could happen — and how new technology can help detect those threats

item.title: San Diego's only all-girls high school builds sisterhood and prepares students for the future
item.description: The Academy of Our Lady of Peace has been shaping young women in San Diego for more than 140 years, and it remains the only all-girls high school in the county.

item.title: Little Leaguers beat the heat as season continues in La Mesa
item.description: Despite a heat wave across East County, Little League players in La Mesa are still taking the field — with coaches and organizers working hard to keep the kids safe while the season continues.
